newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Zebulon, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Zebulon, N.J..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 4th Floor, Room 411, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North Carolina 27603-1385 until 11:00 A.M., North Carolina Time,

such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of $2,940,000 Water and Sewer Bonds, Series 1997 of the Town of Zebulon, North Carolina, dated August 1, 1997, and maturing (subject to the right of prior redemption) annually, February 1, as follows:

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919-733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form.
